research_question: Does state/task-conditioned operational-goal selection improve overall navigation through manipulation-required scenes under unchanged frozen NAV/PUSH/CLIMB execution and safety?
method_scope: navigation target selection and evaluation only; no new actor or controller

controlled_core_arms.description: same SE2 candidate set and actual original-planner route cost; no new reachability filter
N0 plus exact task pose IK under measured state and same bounded solver budget
N1 plus original joint/self-clearance endpoint conditions
N2 plus same nominal path sampled conditions; path increment may be zero

separate_optional_arms.description: N3 plus prior frozen rho preference; do not claim gain from tiny static clearance changes
same selector P3 off/on CPU shadow efficiency benchmark; fixed candidate/IK budgets, no saved-budget reinvestment
unaltered original fixed-approach planner for external reference, NOT the controlled matched-domain N0

paired_conditions: same NAV/PUSH/CLIMB policy and normalizer SHA
all native safety and success predicates remain enabled
all initial cases including refusals, exceptions and early safety stops remain in denominators
primary_outcome: actual original overall navigation goal completion from initial state, not IK validity or NAV arrival alone
secondary_outcomes: actual operational handoff and stage completion
failure-penalized total time under shared original horizon
paper_evidence_rule: static model studies and unit fixtures never populate physical navigation-success/safety fields; absent increments must be reported, not tuned away
later_confirmatory_design: only after viable pilot: independently preregister scene-family groups and paired initial states, report per-group paired effects and uncertainty; no automatic new budget

missing: exact compatible frozen end-to-end Go2+Piper NAV-to-manipulation run package and policy/normalizer/source SHA
actual current-state query and original safety/fallback/overall-success bindings
actual original-planner route cost on the compatible frozen live snapshot; static synthetic Astar bridge is already validated but is not this live binding
separate allocated physical-start/time budget and remote isolation
execution_readiness.responsibility: Reachability prepares selection/evaluation; existing skill execution source remains with its original implementation, no replacement controller
execution_readiness.single_binding_question: Which frozen compatible Go2+Piper NAV-to-manipulation package is the baseline for this chapter?

pilot_completion_conditions: all4 initial states and 4 arms explicitly registered under a NEW source/budget protocol before any start; original old data roles retained
all16 starts or explicit original-safety early-stops accounted for with source, initial state, selected id, native action consumption, phase/time, terminal and original predicates
confirm selected SE2 goal is actually consumed by original NavigateSkill and actual fresh arrival state is used by the unmodified manipulation entry; non-execution is not a failed hypothesis
report paired overall goal outcomes, native safety, full cost and missingness without dropping refusals/aborts; no generic paper success claim from four cases
no automatic additional seeds/variants, threshold/role changes or physical budget expansion after a negative or incomplete pilot
